name: value + prior-art / competitiveness

P1.closest: LLM-Driven Heuristic Synthesis for hot steel rolling (2603.20537) — post-hoc monotonicity audit, industrial domain

P2.closest: AutoTTS itself (2605.08083) informal beta-monotonicity; SEVerA (2603.25111) general-correctness verified synthesis

prior_art_done_already.consensus: NO_COLLISION (unanimous, two independent ~22-query sweeps). The 5-part combination — AutoTTS-style controller synthesis + hard code-structure invariant + monotone-non-decreasing-in-accumulated-compute + stop/prune thresholds + synthesis-time enforcement — has no direct prior art.

value.consensus: MODEST_INCREMENTAL (unanimous). Field is hot (TTS controller design, real production demand) and the failure mode (token-efficiency variance, runaway branching) is acknowledged — BUT AutoTTS's beta convention + Confidence-Momentum-Controller's conservative branch-abandonment already capture most of the practical benefit, so the within-episode invariant's gain is confined to hard-problem TAIL variance, not mean performance. V2 flagged a genuine ACCURACY RISK: hard monotonicity blocks the controller from becoming MORE conservative after a confidence collapse (entropy-trajectory work 2603.18940 links non-monotone chains to wrong answers); and 'provable' overstates guarantees (holds over controller code, not the stochastic end-to-end system).

result: PASS Stage 5 — no exact prior-art collision; value modest-incremental.
ev_gate_expectation: MODEST_INCREMENTAL < promote-threshold SIGNIFICANT -> EV gate points to SEED_ONLY. Per R9, the terminal EV verdict is rendered by the Stage-7 viability AGENT (not the orchestrator); recorded here only as an expectation.
competitiveness_summary: Competitive-with but not clearly-superior-to AutoTTS baseline; primarily adds a GUARANTEE dimension (verifiable within-episode monotonicity) the baselines lack, at the cost of a real over-constraining/accuracy risk. Recommended validation: ablate monotone-constraint vs unconstrained CMC on hard math (AIME); promote only if >~20% token-cost CoV reduction at <1-2% accuracy loss.
